name: input-otp
useFor: Use for a short code sent by SMS or email (sign-in, a card reveal). Set maxLength and pattern={REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS}, group the slots with InputOTPGroup and split long codes with InputOTPSeparator. Paste and SMS autofill fill every slot.
title: Input OTP
description: Joined square slots in the brand's field for a one-time code, the active slot outlined in blue.
